text: dsh-skill-prompt-injector 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的侧栏插件，通过右侧面板浏览当前会话可用的 Skill、管理个人 Prompt，并将所选内容追加到对话输入框。用户可以收藏和标记条目、保存常用组合，也可把 Skill 描述与 Prompt 设为跨对话生效的系统提示段。Skill 通过 DSH 原生调用形式进入草稿，Prompt 正文直接追加；插件不会代替用户发送。安装需兼容 DSH 0.2.1 rc.3 系列，使用 Node.js 22 及以上版本；配置数据保存在本地，无需额外 API Key。

dsh-skill-prompt-injector adds a DSH web sidebar for browsing session skills, managing prompts, and inserting selected items into the draft. Users can save combinations and add selected content to a system prompt across conversations. It leaves sending to the user and needs no API key.
想从侧边栏快速查找当前会话可用的 Skill，并把选中的技能命令放进草稿。
我有一些常用提示词，想保存起来并在需要时追加到 DSH 输入框。
I want to save reusable prompt snippets and insert them into my DSH draft when needed.
dsh-skill-prompt-injector 的功能「选择并填入条目」：从当前会话可用 Skill 和本地 Prompt 中选择内容，按顺序追加到输入框草稿；输入框忙碌或条目缺失时会阻止写入，内容由用户检查后发送。
dsh-skill-prompt-injector 的功能「跨会话全局注入」：将选中的 Skill 描述和 Prompt 设为系统提示段，可在侧栏启停并调整顺序；开启后这些内容会随每次模型请求生效。

dsh-skill-prompt-injector README · dsh-skill-prompt-injector：**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

**Search, pin, combine and inject skills & prompts into the current conversation — from the DSH right sidebar.**

dsh-skill-prompt-injector README · Features：- **Skills catalog** — mirrors the live DSH skill registry of the current session (workspace and agent-preset aware), with search across name, description, body and tags.
- **Prompts** — create, edit and delete your own reusable snippets.
- **Tags & favorites** — both entry kinds can be favorited and tagged locally.
- **Global injection** — pin skills and prompts as always-on context: the host registers them as a system-prompt section, so every new conversation starts with them and edits apply on the next request.
- **Combinations** — save a named set of skills + prompts, load it later, rename it, or update it in place. Combinations always reference the latest prompt body.
- **One-click inject** — appends the selection to the current composer as plain text, keeping your draft, references and attachments; `Ctrl+Z` undoes the insertion in one step.
- **Never sends for you** — injection only fills the draft; you review and send.
- **Kept mounted** — lives in the right sidebar beside the shipped tabs, so switching sessions does not tear it down.

dsh-skill-prompt-injector README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.2.2` (declared as `engines.dsh`)
- A DSH build that provides the right sidebar slot `sidebar.right.pane.tab`

dsh-skill-prompt-injector README · Install：From the npm registry — recommended, the package ships prebuilt `lib/`, so there is nothing to clone or build:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-skill-prompt-injector
```

Or from source:

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/Larliers/dsh-skill-prompt-injector.git
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:<absolute-path-to-clone>
```

Either way, restart DSH afterwards so both the Host and the Client side load the new artifacts.

dsh-skill-prompt-injector README · Usage：1. Open the right sidebar and pick **Skills & prompts** (技能与快捷提示).
2. Toggle entries in the **Skills** tab; switch to **Prompts** to manage snippets.
3. Use **Combinations** to save or load a named set.
4. Press **Append to composer** (追加到当前对话输入框), review the draft, then send.

Skills resolve from the session's workspace and agent preset; the body itself is loaded by DSH's native `/skill-name` mechanism after you send. Dragging only changes injection order — it does not build a serial workflow.

dsh-skill-prompt-injector README · Data：Favorites, tags, combinations and prompts live outside the package, under `$DSH_HOME/skill-prompt-injector/` (default `~/.dsh/skill-prompt-injector/`):

- `prompts.json` — titles, bodies, tags and favorites of your snippets
- `library.json` — skill tags/favorites, and combination references and order

dsh-skill-prompt-injector README · Data：Both files carry `schemaVersion: 1` plus a Host-maintained `revision`; edit them through the UI. Writes are version-checked, serialized and atomic, and `.bak` keeps the previous valid file. The plugin never rewrites your `SKILL.md` files.

Point `dataDirectory` in the plugin Config elsewhere if you prefer another location.

dsh-skill-prompt-injector README · Development：```powershell
npm ci
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build

Output: `lib/index.js` (Host) and `lib/client.js` (Client). The two halves talk over the native Typert Remote channel — no extra server or MCP.

- **Tags & favorites** — both entry kinds can be favorited and tagged locally.
- **Global injection** — pin skills and prompts as always-on context: the host registers them as a system-prompt section, so every new conversation starts with them and edits apply on the next request.
- **Combinations** — save a named set of skills + prompts, load it later, rename it, or update it in place. Combinations always reference the latest prompt body.
- **One-click inject** — appends the selection to the current composer as plain text, keeping your draft, references and attachments; `Ctrl+Z` undoes the insertion in one step.
- **Never sends for you** — injection only fills the draft; you review and send.
- **Kept mounted** — lives in the right sidebar beside the shipped tabs, so switching sessions does not tear it down.

dsh-skill-prompt-injector README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.2.2` (declared as `engines.dsh`)
- A DSH build that provides the right sidebar slot `sidebar.right.pane.tab`

dsh-skill-prompt-injector README · Install：From the npm registry — recommended, the package ships prebuilt `lib/`, so there is nothing to clone or build:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-skill-prompt-injector
```

Or from source:

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/Larliers/dsh-skill-prompt-injector.git
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:<absolute-path-to-clone>
```

Either way, restart DSH afterwards so both the Host and the Client side load the new artifacts.

dsh-skill-prompt-injector README · Usage：1. Open the right sidebar and pick **Skills & prompts** (技能与快捷提示).
2. Toggle entries in the **Skills** tab; switch to **Prompts** to manage snippets.
3. Use **Combinations** to save or load a named set.
4. Press **Append to composer** (追加到当前对话输入框), review the draft, then send.

Skills resolve from the session's workspace and agent preset; the body itself is loaded by DSH's native `/skill-name` mechanism after you send. Dragging only changes injection order — it does not build a serial workflow.

dsh-skill-prompt-injector README · Data：Favorites, tags, combinations and prompts live outside the package, under `$DSH_HOME/skill-prompt-injector/` (default `~/.dsh/skill-prompt-injector/`):

- `prompts.json` — titles, bodies, tags and favorites of your snippets
- `library.json` — skill tags/favorites, and combination references and order

dsh-skill-prompt-injector README · Data：Both files carry `schemaVersion: 1` plus a Host-maintained `revision`; edit them through the UI. Writes are version-checked, serialized and atomic, and `.bak` keeps the previous valid file. The plugin never rewrites your `SKILL.md` files.

Point `dataDirectory` in the plugin Config elsewhere if you prefer another location.

dsh-skill-prompt-injector README · Development：```powershell
npm ci
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build

Output: `lib/index.js` (Host) and `lib/client.js` (Client). The two halves talk over the native Typert Remote channel — no extra server or MCP.
